title: Dataset "Can employees benefit from Appreciative Inquiry? Evidence from quasi-experiments to improve work engagement and vigour within healthcare"

contacts.name: van de Ven, David
contacts.affiliation: The Erasmus Happiness Economics Research Organisation (EHERO)

descriptions: The dataset, codebook, and syntax file are related to a research article. The study aimed to evaluate, within a Dutch elderly care organization: 1) the effectiveness of team-based (quasi-) experiments developed using appreciative inquiry on job resources, team crafting, work engagement, and vigor of healthcare professionals, and 2) the impact of the experimental process on the effectiveness of these experiments.
